links.comparator_used: No prompting (default query with no reading-level or audience instruction)
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of ChatGPT answers
links.effect: Patient-friendly prompting mean grade level 12.45 ± 2.32 vs no prompting 14.15 ± 1.59 (physician-level 14.27 ± 2.09; statistics/references 15.00 ± 2.26); P < .0001. Correctness (at least correct) did not differ by prompt, P = .453.
links.tradeoff: Even with patient-friendly prompting, responses stayed above the recommended reading level for patient information.
links.quote: Responses from patient-friendly prompting had a lower mean grade level (12.45 ± 2.32) than no prompting (14.15 ± 1.59), physician-level prompting (14.27 ± 2.09), and statistics/references prompting (15.00 ± 2.26) (P < .0001).
